scope: Reviewed OMAI formula endpoints and exact Lean proof source for the Boltzmann electronic transport coefficients anchored to Physlib's thermoelectric material. Hash and compiled-name checks detect drift and provenance errors; they are not automatic symbolic translation or numerical validation.
interpretations: All three producers are opaque Boltzmann-transport outputs in the catalog. The interpreted definitions are BoltzTraP2's Onsager coefficients on a finite energy grid: with weights w_b >= 0 (the diagonal transport distribution times the Fermi window -df/dE times the bin width) and grid energies E_b, L_k = sum_b w_b (E_b - mu)^k, sigma = e^2 L_0, S = -(L_1/L_0)/(e T) and kappa_e = (L_2 - L_1^2/L_0)/T. The scattering model enters only through w, so any relaxation-time model is admitted.

e > 0 is the elementary charge, so electrons above mu give a negative Seebeck coefficient. kappa_e is the zero-current electronic thermal conductivity; -L_1^2/L_0 is the Peltier correction to the zero-field L_2/T.

At T > 0, kappa_e >= 0, with equality exactly when every state with nonzero weight has one energy (a delta-function transport distribution). For L_0 > 0, e != 0, T > 0 and any kappa_l > 0 the coefficients are the fields of a Physlib ThermoelectricMaterial, and when L_0 L_2 - L_1^2 > 0 and L_1 != 0 every such material has figure of merit strictly below L_1^2/(L_0 L_2 - L_1^2), a bound approached as kappa_l -> 0 (Mahan-Sofo).

OMAISommerfeldTransport.lean, imported by the proof source, holds the continuum moments: for the kinetic integrals K_k = int Sigma_0 (E - mu)^k (-df/dE) dE of an energy-independent transport distribution, K_0 = Sigma_0, K_1 = 0 and K_2 = Sigma_0 (k_B T)^2 pi^2/3, so the same three formulas give S = 0 and kappa_e = (pi^2/3)(k_B/e)^2 sigma T. It defines no catalog endpoint.
